text:
tanya: quick idea after the DB incident — what if we run a 72h postmortem tidy-sprint: compact list of quick fixes (48h), a watch window (72h) for recurrence, and a handoff plan for deeper RCA if needed. thoughts?

ajay: yes. require owner + exact verify command for each quick fix. eliminates the 'i thought you had it' loop.

maria: i'll take short-term mitigations (breaker + smoke). can ship to canary in ~3h.

lucas: i'll set up a 72h watch dashboard and run anomaly scans across 120d. will flag any recurring signature.

rachel: small ops tweak: rotate IC after the incident if the same person is doing postmortem ops more than twice a month. keeps fresh eyes.

incident-bot: Task created: INC-4788 - 72h tidy-sprint. Owners: maria, lucas, tanya. https://internal/tasks/INC-4788

ajay: propose compact tracker template in the incident doc: `task | owner | ETA | quick-verify | severity(quick/med/long)` one-line per action.

tanya: i'll add that template now and seed the quick fixes. also adding a short 'who's IC next' line so rotation is explicit.

maria: PR up with breaker + `curl` smoke-check and rollback note: https://git/repo/patch4788

lucas: alert clusters posted to the dashboard: https://dash/alerts/DB-patterns-120d 1 - weekly batch alignment is noisy; isolating true anomalies now.

rachel: for IC rotation: can we add a tiny rule in the playbook: "IC role should rotate if same person led >2 incidents in 30d" and a lightweight secondary IC step for 48h watch?

ajay: agreed. also tag each action with expected owner effort (hrs) so PMs can triage resources.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h check-in for INC-4788.

tanya: great. thanks team 1 - tracker link: https://docs.redwood/incident/INC-4788/tidy-sprint. we'll reconvene in 24h here and decide RCA slot based on lucas's watch.
